concerns.text: Task T012b (Geometry Calibration) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T011 (Dataset Download) to access the raw dataset manifest containing screen width, viewing distance, and sampling rate. A task cannot run in parallel if it requires an artifact produced by a preceding task in the same phase. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

Task T012c (Temporal-Load Check) is marked [P] but depends on T011 (Dataset Download) to verify `stimulus_duration_ms` in the metadata. It cannot execute until the data is fetched. Marking it [P] implies it can run concurrently with T011, which is impossible.

Task T013 (I-VT Algorithm) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on the output of T012b ('Use the calculated pixel-threshold from T012b'). A task consuming a specific artifact from another task cannot be parallel-safe with that producer. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T014 (Stimulus Mapping) is marked [P] but depends on T011 (Dataset Download) to access the raw data containing stimulus IDs. It cannot run until the data is present. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T015 (STAI Merging) is marked [P] but depends on T011 (Dataset Download) to access the STAI scores. It cannot run in parallel with the download task. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T016 (Trial Filtering) is marked [P] but depends on T013 (I-VT Extraction) to have generated the fixation data to filter. It cannot run until T013 completes. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T017 (Generate CSV) is marked [P] but depends on the output of T016 (Filtered Trials). It cannot run in parallel with the filtering task. The [P] tag is invalid.

Task T020 (Model Fitting) is marked [P] but the 'User Story Dependencies' section explicitly states US2 'Requires output from US1 (`data/processed/analysis.csv`)'. T020 cannot run until T017 completes. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T022 (LRT) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Model Fitting) to produce the full and reduced models. It cannot run in parallel with the model fitting. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T023 (Residual Diagnostics) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Model Fitting) to produce the model object. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is invalid.

Task T023b (Bootstrap Convergence) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Model Fitting) to establish the baseline convergence logic and likely the model object. It cannot run in parallel with the primary fit. The [P] tag is invalid.

Task T024 (Power Analysis) is marked [P] but the Plan (Phase 2.5) states it must be 'based on the observed sample size and variance components from the fitted model'. This creates a hard dependency on T020. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T028 (Marginal Effects Calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Model Fitting) to provide the coefficients. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T029 (Plot Generation) is marked [P] but depends on T028 (Calculation) to provide the slopes and CIs. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T030 (Headless Rendering) is marked [P] but depends on T029 (Plot Generation) to create the figure object. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T031 (Save Plot) is marked [P] but depends on T030 (Rendering) to have the figure ready. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is invalid.
